name: Sebastián sierra
bio: Colombian actor born in Cartagena. He played Belisario in Brothers Under Fire and featured as Lorenzo in Father Joe alongside Kiefer Sutherland, Al Pacino, and Michael Rispoli.

credits.title: Brothers Under Fire
credits.overview: Captain Jordan Wright's squadron on leave for a wedding in Mexico encounters a murderous cartel. As Jordan tries to lead survivors to safety, war erupts between his squad and the cartel, forcing him into a battle to save his men.
